title: End-to-end JSON Output Validator and E2E Scenarios for Constrained Decoding
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Build a reusable end-to-end validation harness that exercises JSON mode enforcement and constrained decoding across: streaming responses, tool/function calling flows, and compatibility fallbacks for different model families. The harness should run in CI and as a nightly matrix job covering model variants, quantization profiles, and SDK permutations (REST, Node, Python). Goal: detect schema drift and decoding regressions before deploys.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic test matrix defined that covers at minimum: streaming + JSON mode, tool-calling + constrained decoding, and fallback model routes
E2E harness can simulate partial tokens (stream fragmentation) and still validate final JSON output against provided JSON Schema
CI job passes on canonical prompts and fails with clear diagnostics when model emits invalid JSON or violates schema constraints
Artifacts (raw token streams, parsed attempts, failure diffs) are archived to the test dashboard for triage
Integration tests run against local runtime and dedicated staging cluster; passing runs required before runtime-1.20 branch merge
tasks: Design test matrix and minimal schema corpus (PM + QA review)
Implement stream replayer that can inject token splits and simulated network chunking
Add constrained-decoding verification layer that validates intermediate partial outputs and final JSON against schemas
Wire harness into CI with per-model tags and an opt-in nightly expanded matrix
Create failure diagnostics: token-level diff, schema path errors, and suggestion hints for prompts or model config
Run canary against dedicated staging pool and collect regressions; file follow-up ENG tickets for model-specific fixes
notes: This ticket extends previous structured-output contract work but focuses on end-to-end resiliency across streaming and tool-call scenarios.
Prefer using JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 for validation; include a small set of permissive and strict schemas to exercise edge cases.
Keep the harness language-agnostic; produce a thin CLI wrapper used by both Node and Python SDK CI jobs.
We must ensure tests do not assume a single model; parameterize model_family, quant_profile, and decode_strategy.
Coordinate with infra to reserve a small dedicated staging pool for deterministic canary runs to avoid noisy neighbor effects.
